name: Seraphim
source:
Lilim’s childhood friend. Serra is a cupid who lives in Heaven. She graduated from the Cupid Academy at the top of her class, and is incredibly gifted and able. Despite being so talented, she doesn’t have many friends, as she acts cold and aloof.

Serra is very serious, but has a secret love for cute, cuddly toys, and magical girl shows. She’ll never admit to it, though – just like she’ll never admit how much she loves Lilim.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/733740/Sakura_Cupid/]Steam[/url]]
